evidence: `RawLimits` (Extraction/Lipschitz.lean:156-160) and `VolumePoints` (Extraction/Limits.lean:64-66) give only value convergence on compact K ⊆ generic n, i.e. coordinates distinct on every axis (Space/Configurations.lean:66), a set smaller than Conf_n.
